how_to.python:
import requests

API = "https://www.capmas.gov.eg:8080"
headers = {"locale": "en"}
# publications (one row per edition) of sub-subject 21 = Vital Statistics
r = requests.get(f"{API}/api/Publication/Search", headers=headers,
                 params={"SubjectId": 21, "PageSize": 100, "CurrentPage": 1}, timeout=60)
editions = r.json()["data"]
# one indicator's values (2004 = final divorce judgments by governorate)
r = requests.get(f"{API}/api/Indicator/IndicatorFilter", headers=headers,
                 params={"IndicatorId": 2004, "SubSubjectId": 21}, timeout=60)
series = r.json()["data"]  # [{name: governorate, data: [{year, value}, ...]}, ...]
